Name: Live Code
Author: CNLynx
Description: Claude Code live on your Stream Deck: what each chat does, context and limits, prompts at a press, Claude's questions answered with a key, stop, and a glow when a task is done.

Actions.Name: Live Code key
Actions.Tooltip: One key of the Live Code page: what it shows and does follows from where it sits. The Live Code profile has all fifteen.

Actions.Name: Open Live Code
Actions.Tooltip: Put it on your main page: it shows whether Claude works, glows when a task is done, and opens the Live Code page.
